text: Home-ops news pieces on court cases drown in legal nouns: 'restitution', 'administratively dissolved', 'AG' pushed Flesch to 42.4. Write 'builder', 'pay-back', 'struck from the registry', 'the attorney general's office' from the first draft — the reviewer rewrite cannot invent plainer nouns without risking the figure ledger, and two review attempts were spent re-diction.

The By-the-numbers critic rejects a bullet whose lead-in carries one figure and whose clause carries a second ('1/3 of the deal price: … 3,666 on this 81,000 job'). Lead the bullet on the single scannable figure and let the clause name only the thing it is measured against.

The observer-cue regex wants the words 'My reading'/'My read', not 'My own reading' — an inserted possessive breaks the match; and a cue the rewrite drops from the catch must be re-added by hand. Adopt a HELD attempt and repair cues to the literal forms: 'My reading, held loosely…' or 'What I find hard to argue with…'.
